items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: Dickie Wells came through my home with Cecil Scott. I thought he was the most phenomenal trombone player I had ever heard.

ctx.x: Dickie Wells came through my home with Cecil Scott. I thought he was the most phenomenal trombone player I had ever heard. He was making a lot of glisses and he was -- he could almost do a conversation with the horn. Then later on when I heard him, he had left Cecil and he went with Teddy Hill. Then later he went with Basie and stayed with Basie a long time. He did a lot of good recordings with Basie, a lot of good recordings.
